function.name: Software engineering
function.description: Building, reviewing, testing and operating software: the delivery capability for every other function.

jobs.name: Implement a scoped change from a written task
jobs.outcome: A task with clear scope becomes a mergeable change that passes tests and review with limited rework.

jobs.name: Investigate incidents to a root cause
jobs.outcome: An incident is investigated from logs, metrics and changes to a root cause a responder confirms.

jobs.name: Keep dependencies current and safe
jobs.outcome: Dependency updates are proposed, tested and merged, and known vulnerabilities are closed within the policy window.

jobs.name: Review pull requests for defects and risks
jobs.outcome: A pull request receives review comments that find real defects and risks a careful reviewer would, with few false alarms.

jobs.name: Triage incoming issues and reproduce them
jobs.outcome: New issues are labeled, deduplicated and reproduced or marked unreproducible, with the steps recorded.

jobs.name: Write and maintain documentation from the code
jobs.outcome: Documentation is written from the code and kept current as it changes, and readers find what they need.

jobs.name: Write tests that cover a change or a module
jobs.outcome: Tests are added that fail on the defect and pass on the fix, and coverage of the changed code rises.
